meta.title: Computer Labs
meta.description: Computer labs at XLRI Delhi-NCR, with networked workstations and business software including SAS and SAP.

title: Computer Labs
intro: Computer labs with rows of workstations give students hands-on time with the software and databases their courses use.

photos.alt: Rows of computer workstations in a lab

highlights.title: Workstations
highlights.text: Rows of networked desktop computers, with printers and scanners close by.

highlights.title: Business software
highlights.text: Packages such as SAS and Oracle, and web-hosted SAP for hands-on ERP through the University Alliance programme.

highlights.title: Always connected
highlights.text: On the campus gigabit fibre network, with round-the-clock intranet and internet access.

related.label: IT Infrastructure
related.description: A gigabit fibre backbone, 1500 Mbps of bandwidth and campus-wide access.

related.label: Classrooms
related.description: Tiered lecture theatres and case-discussion rooms.

related.label: Studio
related.description: A branded studio set for photos, videos and recordings.
